caption:
Deterministic matching weights required terms double and preferred terms once.

In JobRez, role match is deterministic: a curated technology taxonomy with aliases, whole-word matching, required terms weighted double and preferred terms once, with no cloud AI and no external verification.

You keep one master resume; branches are copies tailored per role, and each branch is scored against the posting in Job DNA.

Read more at jobrez.com.
